SAMPLE LESSON NOTE ON PRE-NURSERY HEALTH HABITS (FIRST TERM) WEEK 1: INTRODUCTION TO OUR BODY Our body is everything that makes us. It has many parts and each part has a name. Body Parts: Head: This is at the top of our body. It is round. Our brain is inside our head. We wear caps and hats on our head. Face: This is the front part of our head. Our eyes, nose, mouth, and ears are on our face. We use our face to smile and show our feelings. Hands: We have two hands. Our hands help us hold things, eat food, play with toys, and wave hello and goodbye. Each hand has five fingers. Legs: We have two legs. Our legs help us stand, walk, run, and jump. At the end of each leg is a foot with five toes. Body: This means all of us together - from head to feet. Our body is special and we must take care of it. Why Our Body is Important: Our body helps us do many things. We use our body to play, eat, learn, and grow. Each part works together to help us every day. Taking Care of Our Body: We must keep our body clean and healthy. We do this by bathing regularly, eating good food, drinking water, and resting well. When we take care of our body, we stay strong and healthy. EVALUATION: 1. Point to your head 2. Where are your hands? 3. Touch your legs 4. Show me your face 5. Say "body" with teacher ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help your child at home by:  Singing body parts songs together  Pointing to and naming body parts during bath time  Playing "touch your head/hands/legs" game  Letting your child look in the mirror to see their body parts WEEK 2: CARE OF THE SKIN I - BATHING REGULARLY Our skin covers our whole body. We must keep our skin clean by bathing every day. What is Bathing? Bathing means washing our body with water and soap. When we bathe, we clean all the dirt from our skin. We should bathe every day to stay clean and healthy. Things We Use for Bathing: Water: We use clean water to wash our body. Water helps remove dirt from our skin. Soap: Soap makes foam and bubbles. It helps clean our skin and makes us smell nice. We rub soap on our body when bathing. Sponge: A sponge is soft. We use it to scrub our body gently. The sponge helps the soap clean our skin better. Towel: After bathing, we use a towel to dry our body. The towel soaks up the water from our skin. How We Bathe: First, we wet our body with water. Then we apply soap and use the sponge to wash all parts of our body - our arms, legs, chest, back, and everywhere. After washing, we rinse off the soap with clean water. Then we dry our body with a clean towel. Why We Should Bathe Every Day:  To remove dirt and germs from our skin  To keep our body clean and fresh  To smell nice  To stay healthy and strong  To feel comfortable and happy When we bathe regularly, our skin is clean, we smell good, and we feel fresh. People like to be around children who are clean and smell nice. EVALUATION: 1. Show how we wash our body (mime the action) 2. Point to the soap 3. What do we use to dry our body? 4. When should we bathe? (Every day) 5. Can you identify the sponge? ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please support your child by:  Naming bathing materials as you use them during bath time  Singing bathing songs while bathing your child  Letting your child observe the bathing process  Encouraging good bathing habits daily WEEK 3: CARE OF THE SKIN II - APPLYING BODY CREAM After we finish bathing, we must dry our body and apply cream. This keeps our skin soft and healthy. Drying Our Body: When we finish bathing and rinse off all the soap, our body is wet. We must dry it with a clean towel. We pat the towel gently on our skin - on our arms, legs, body, and everywhere until we are dry. A wet body can make us feel cold, so we must dry properly. Applying Body Cream: After drying, we apply body cream on our skin. Body cream is also called lotion. It is smooth and soft. We take some cream in our hands and rub it gently on our arms, legs, and body. The cream makes our skin soft, smooth, and shiny. Applying Hair Cream: We also apply cream on our hair. Hair cream keeps our hair healthy, soft, and neat. It makes our hair look nice and prevents it from being dry. Why We Apply Cream:  To keep our skin soft and smooth  To prevent dry skin  To make our body look healthy and shiny  To keep our hair neat and healthy  To smell fresh and nice The Complete Routine: After bathing, we follow these steps: 1. Dry our body with a clean towel 2. Apply body cream all over our skin 3. Apply hair cream on our hair When we do this every day after bathing, our skin stays soft and our hair stays healthy. We look clean, neat, and well taken care of. Materials We Use: Towel: Soft cloth to dry our body after bathing Body Cream/Lotion: Smooth cream to make our skin soft Hair Cream: Special cream for our hair to keep it healthy EVALUATION: 1. What do we use to dry our body? (Towel) 2. Show how to dry your body (mime the action) 3. When do we apply cream? (After bathing) 4. Pretend to apply cream on your arms 5. Point to the body cream ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help your child by:  Showing the drying and cream application process  Naming the items: towel, body cream, hair cream  Letting your child help apply cream with supervision  Making this part of the daily bathing routine WEEK 4: CARE OF THE SKIN III - MATERIALS USED Today we will learn about all the materials we use to take care of our skin. These materials help us keep our body clean and healthy. All Skin Care Materials: 1.Soap: Soap is what we use to wash our body. It can be bar soap or liquid soap. When we mix soap with water, it makes foam and bubbles. Soap removes dirt and germs from our skin. It makes us clean and smell nice. We use soap every time we bathe. 2.Sponge: The sponge is soft and absorbs water. We use the sponge to scrub our body when bathing. It helps spread the soap all over our skin and cleans better. Some sponges are soft and gentle on our skin. We squeeze the sponge to make foam with the soap. 3.Towel: The towel is made of soft cloth. We use it to dry our body after bathing. Towels absorb water from our wet skin. We should use a clean towel each time we bathe. After using the towel, we hang it up to dry. 4.Body Cream/Lotion: This is smooth cream that we apply on our skin after drying. It comes in bottles or containers. Body cream keeps our skin soft and prevents it from being dry and rough. It makes our skin smooth and shiny. 5.Hair Cream: This is special cream for our hair. It keeps our hair soft, healthy, and easy to comb. Hair cream makes our hair look neat and shiny. We apply it after bathing when our hair is still a bit damp. How We Use These Materials: For bathing, we use water, soap, and sponge to wash our body clean. After rinsing, we use the towel to dry. Then we apply body cream on our skin and hair cream on our hair. All these materials work together to keep us clean and healthy. Keeping Materials Clean: We must keep our bathing materials clean:  Rinse the soap after using it  Squeeze out water from the sponge and let it dry  Hang the towel to dry after use  Close cream containers after using them  Keep all materials in a clean place Complete Skin Care Routine: 1. Wet body with clean water 2. Apply soap and use sponge to wash all body parts 3. Rinse body with clean water to remove soap 4. Dry body with clean towel 5. Apply body cream on skin 6. Apply hair cream on hair When we use all these materials properly, our skin stays clean, soft, and healthy. We look neat and feel good about ourselves. EVALUATION: 1. Point to the soap when asked 2. Which material do we use to dry our body? 3. Match the sponge to its picture 4. What do we use to make our skin soft? (Body cream) 5. Name any material used for skin care ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help your child by:  Showing all bathing materials at home  Asking your child to identify each item  Playing "Find the soap/towel/sponge" game  Letting your child help arrange bathing materials  Praising correct identification WEEK 7: CARE OF THE MOUTH AND TEETH I - INTRODUCTION Welcome back! Today we begin learning about another important part of our body - our mouth and teeth. What is the Mouth? The mouth is the opening on our face where we eat food and talk. It is below our nose. We open and close our mouth many times every day. Our mouth has lips on the outside and teeth, tongue, and gums inside. What are Teeth? Teeth are the hard, white things inside our mouth. When we open our mouth wide and look in a mirror, we can see our teeth. Teeth are very important. We have small teeth in the front and bigger teeth at the back of our mouth. Why Are Teeth Important? For Eating: Our teeth help us bite and chew our food. When we eat an apple, we bite it with our front teeth. When we chew our food, we use our back teeth. Without teeth, we cannot eat properly. For Speaking: Our teeth help us talk clearly. They help us say certain words correctly. Try saying "tooth" - your tongue touches your teeth when you say it. For Smiling: Our teeth make our smile beautiful. When we smile, people see our white, clean teeth. A good smile makes us look happy and friendly. For Health: Healthy teeth mean a healthy body. When our teeth are clean and strong, we can eat well and stay healthy. Types of Teeth: We have different types of teeth in our mouth, but at your age, the important thing to know is that all our teeth are precious and we must take care of them. Healthy Teeth vs Unhealthy Teeth: Healthy teeth are clean, white, and strong. They do not hurt. Children with healthy teeth can eat all kinds of food without pain. Unhealthy teeth may be dirty, have black spots, or cause pain. When we don't take care of our teeth, they can become unhealthy and hurt us. How to Have Healthy Teeth: To keep our teeth healthy, we must:  Brush them regularly  Keep them clean  Eat good food  Visit the dentist when needed Our teeth are precious. We must learn to take care of them properly so they stay white, clean, and strong throughout our life. EVALUATION: 1. Point to your mouth 2. Open your mouth and show your teeth 3. What do teeth help us do? (Eat, talk, smile) 4. Which picture shows healthy teeth? (Clean, white teeth) 5. Show how you chew food ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help your child by:  Letting them look at their teeth in a mirror  Talking about how teeth help us eat and smile  Pointing out healthy teeth when you see smiles  Making dental health awareness fun and positive WEEK 8: CARE OF THE MOUTH AND TEETH II - BRUSHING TWICE DAILY Now that we know about our teeth, we must learn how to keep them clean and healthy. The best way to care for our teeth is by brushing them regularly. What is Tooth Brushing? Tooth brushing means cleaning our teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste. When we eat food, small pieces can stick to our teeth. If we don't remove them, our teeth can become dirty and unhealthy. Brushing helps remove food and dirt from our teeth. How Many Times Should We Brush? We must brush our teeth TWO times every day: 1.Morning Brushing: We brush our teeth in the morning when we wake up. Some people brush before breakfast, others brush after breakfast. The important thing is to brush in the morning. This removes all the dirt that stayed on our teeth while we slept. 2. Night Brushing: We brush our teeth at night before going to bed. This is very important because it cleans our teeth before we sleep. When we sleep with clean teeth, they stay healthy. How to Remember When to Brush: Think about the sun and the moon:  When the sun comes up in the morning - brush your teeth!  When the moon comes out at night - brush your teeth! That makes TWO times every day. We can count: "One" (morning), "Two" (night). How We Brush Our Teeth: 1. Wet the toothbrush with water 2. Put a tiny bit of toothpaste on the brush 3. Brush the front of your teeth - up and down 4. Brush the back of your teeth - up and down 5. Brush the top parts where you chew - back and forth 6. Brush gently - don't brush too hard 7. Brush for a little while - not too fast 8. Rinse your mouth with water 9. Spit out the water and toothpaste Why Must We Brush Twice Daily?  To remove food stuck between our teeth  To keep our teeth white and clean  To prevent teeth from hurting  To keep our mouth fresh  To prevent bad breath  To make our smile beautiful  To keep our teeth strong and healthy What Happens If We Don't Brush? If we don't brush our teeth regularly:  Food remains on our teeth  Teeth become dirty and yellow  Teeth may start to hurt  Our mouth may smell bad  We may get tooth problems But when we brush twice every day, our teeth stay clean, white, and healthy! EVALUATION: 1. Show me how to brush your teeth (mime the action) 2. How many times do we brush? (Two times) 3. When do we brush in the morning? (When the sun is up) 4. When do we brush at night? (Before sleeping/when moon is out) 5. Sing the brushing song with actions ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help establish good brushing habits:  Brush your child's teeth twice daily (morning and night)  Let your child watch you brush your teeth  Make brushing a regular, fun routine  Use the sun/moon reference to help them remember  Praise your child for brushing regularly  Be patient and encouraging WEEK 9: CARE OF THE MOUTH AND TEETH III - USING MOUTHWASH Besides brushing our teeth, there is another way to keep our mouth clean and fresh - using mouthwash. What is Mouthwash? Mouthwash is a special liquid that helps clean our mouth. It comes in a bottle. Mouthwash helps reach places in our mouth that the toothbrush may not clean completely. It makes our breath smell fresh and nice. IMPORTANT SAFETY RULE: Mouthwash should ONLY be used with the help of your parents or guardians. Never use mouthwash by yourself. Always ask an adult to help you. How Mouthwash is Used (With Parent's Help): 1. Ask your parent or guardian to help you 2. Parent pours a little bit of mouthwash into a small cup 3. Take the liquid into your mouth (don't swallow it!) 4. Swish it around in your mouth - move it from side to side gently 5. Keep it in your mouth for a few seconds 6. Spit it out into the sink 7. DO NOT SWALLOW the mouthwash What Does "Swish" Mean? Swishing means moving the liquid around in your mouth. Your cheeks puff out a little and the liquid moves all around your teeth, gums, and tongue. This helps clean all parts of your mouth. Why We Use Mouthwash:  It cleans all parts of the mouth, including places the brush cannot reach  It removes tiny pieces of food  It makes our breath smell fresh  It helps keep our mouth healthy and clean  It makes our mouth feel fresh When Do We Use Mouthwash? Mouthwash is usually used after brushing our teeth. Some families use it in the morning after brushing, some use it at night, and some use it twice a day. Your parents will tell you when to use it. Safety Rules to Remember:  Never use mouthwash without an adult's help  Never swallow mouthwash - always spit it out  If mouthwash gets in your eyes, tell an adult immediately  Never play with the mouthwash bottle  Always ask: "Mom/Dad, please help me use mouthwash" Practice Makes Perfect: Before using real mouthwash, we can practice the swishing and spitting action with plain water. This helps us learn how to do it properly. Once we know how to swish and spit well, then parents can help us use real mouthwash. EVALUATION: 1. Point to the mouthwash bottle 2. Show me how to swish (move your mouth like liquid is swirling) 3. Who should help you use mouthwash? (Parents/adults) 4. Can you practice spitting action? 5. Should we swallow mouthwash? (No, we spit it out) ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Important information about mouthwash:  Always supervise your child when using mouthwash  Use child-friendly, alcohol-free mouthwash if introducing it  Demonstrate proper swishing and spitting  Practice with plain water first  Teach your child never to swallow mouthwash  Consider your child's readiness - it's okay to wait until they're older WEEK 10: CARE OF THE MOUTH AND TEETH IV - MATERIALS USED Today we will learn about all the materials we use to take care of our mouth and teeth. Each material has a special job in keeping our mouth clean and healthy. All Dental Care Materials: 1.Toothbrush: The toothbrush is a small brush with soft bristles. The bristles are the tiny soft hairs at the top of the brush. We use the toothbrush to scrub our teeth clean. Toothbrushes come in different colors and sizes. Children should use small toothbrushes with soft bristles that are gentle on teeth and gums. We should change our toothbrush when the bristles become old and bent. 2.Toothpaste: Toothpaste is a special paste we put on the toothbrush. It comes in a tube. When we squeeze the tube, toothpaste comes out. We only need a tiny bit of toothpaste - about the size of a small pea. Toothpaste has a nice taste and smell. It makes foam when we brush and helps clean our teeth properly. Toothpaste makes our teeth white, clean, and our breath fresh. 3.Cup: We use a small cup to hold water for rinsing our mouth. After brushing, we take water in the cup, put it in our mouth, swish it around, and spit it out. This washes away the toothpaste and any dirt from our teeth. We can also use the cup to hold water for wetting our toothbrush before brushing. The cup should be clean and used only for mouth care. 4.Mouthwash: This is a special liquid in a bottle that helps clean our mouth completely. We use it with our parent's help after brushing. Mouthwash reaches all the corners of our mouth and makes our breath very fresh. Remember, we must never use mouthwash without an adult's help, and we must never swallow it. The Complete Mouth Care Routine: Step 1: Take your toothbrush and wet it with water from the cup Step 2: Put a tiny bit of toothpaste on the toothbrush Step 3: Brush all your teeth - front, back, and top - up and down, back and forth, gently Step 4: Take water in your mouth from the cup and swish it around Step 5: Spit out the water and toothpaste into the sink Step 6: Rinse your mouth again with clean water to make sure all toothpaste is out Step 7: With parent's help, use mouthwash if needed - swish and spit Step 8: Rinse your toothbrush and cup with clean water Step 9: Put everything back in its place Step 10: Smile and show your clean, healthy teeth! Taking Care of Dental Materials: We must take care of our dental care materials:  Rinse the toothbrush after use and let it dry standing up  Close the toothpaste tube after using it  Wash the cup with clean water after use  Keep the mouthwash bottle closed  Store all materials in a clean, dry place  Don't share your toothbrush with anyone Remembering the Routine: Remember to use these materials TWICE every day - in the morning and at night before bed. When we brush twice daily with these materials, our teeth stay white, strong, and healthy. Our smile becomes beautiful and our mouth stays fresh all day. EVALUATION: 1. Point to the toothbrush 2. What do we put on the toothbrush? (Toothpaste) 3. Show me the cup 4. Match each material to its picture 5. Can you show the complete tooth brushing routine? 6. Which materials are used to care for teeth? ASSIGNMENT: Dear Parents/Guardians, Please help reinforce this lesson:  Review all dental materials with your child daily  Let your child identify each item before use  Practice the complete routine together  Ask questions: "Where is your toothbrush?" "What is this?"  Maintain the twice-daily brushing schedule  Make dental care a positive family activity  Praise your child's good dental hygiene habits (for Primary and Secondary Schools) Scheme of Works Lesson Notes Word Educational Software School Management Software School Administrative Packages E-Textbooks and E-Videos Posters Exam Question Bank Charts MOCK Exam Questions School Teaching and Learning Utilities Common Entrance Questions JAMB-UTME Past Questions WAEC Past Questions E-Learning Materials Teaching and Learning Utilities Teaching and Learning Aids
